_doc: Source videos of the clip bench (rsm.bench.clips, development only). truth: gps = a Van Gestel track.gpx with video-aligned timestamps; gps_quality: coarse = the Van Gestel GPS is good for the place only (about 3-5 m off the road, its clock drifts by seconds and jumps; maintainer 2026-11-19: no fine-tuning of speed, heading or timing on it), verified = `verified` names a track checked by the maintainer whose <time> is the video time (Pontaix); open = no reference yet (speed and rotation still to be determined; note says what exists). full = an earlier run of the whole video (motion/, rotation/) used to choose the clip windows and to compare a clip with the same window of the full run; null = windows at fixed shares of the duration. bbox S,W,N,E only feeds the area status of the motion step. manual = windows added by hand (video seconds).
